title: Director of Loan Processing Operations
description:
We are a venture-backed, tech startup seeking an exceptional Director of Loan Processing Operations to lead and scale our nationwide third-party mortgage processing team. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who has personally run large, high-volume mortgage operations and knows exactly what an optimal processing workflow should look like from intake to funding.
The ideal candidate has deep experience from the ground up as a residential mortgage loan processor, has managed teams processing 1,000+ active loans in pipeline, and thrives in a fast-moving startup environment where operational excellence and structured processes must coexist with rapid innovation.
If this sounds like you and you also enjoy the flexibility and leadership opportunity that comes with working at a fully-remote tech startup, we would love to hear from you!
Responsibilities
Operational Leadership & Strategy

• Design, build, and continuously optimize a high-volume, scalable loan processing operation handling hundreds to thousands of residential mortgage loans simultaneously.

• Establish and enforce a team-based processing model, from loan registration to closing & funding.

• Create the operational blueprint for how loans flow through our proprietary, AI-powered software platform, ensuring speed, quality, and regulatory compliance.

People Management

• Recruit, train, lead, and mentor senior mortgage loan processors, junior support staff, and operations manager, and team leads.

• Create workload allocation models to maximize processor throughput and ensure SLAs are consistently met.

• Manage performance standards, coaching plans, and incentives tied to quality, speed, and customer satisfaction.

Process & Workflow Optimization

• Develop and refine SOPs that minimize errors and reduce time to close.

• Identify bottlenecks, root cause issues, and workflow gaps; implement corrective action quickly.

• Provide feedback on workflow design, tasking systems, document handling, SLA automation, and supporting tools.

Quality & Compliance

• Ensure accurate, compliant disclosures and loan file documentation.

• Maintain high standards of data integrity across LOS, lender portals, and internal systems.

• Own quality control initiatives to reduce file errors and post-closing issues.

Client Experience

• Maintain strong relationships with our clients, independent mortgage brokers.

• Resolve client service issues, analyzing the root cause of issues, speaking to clients when an escalation is requested, and improving processes to prevent recurring problems.

• Drive measurable improvements in turn times, processor responsiveness, borrower satisfaction, and client retention.

Required Experience & Qualifications
General Industry Experience

• 10+ years of experience in residential mortgage loan processing and operations.

• Previously worked full-time as a residential mortgage loan processor.

• Managed large-scale processing operations with hundreds to thousands active loans in pipeline or equivalent high-volume responsibility.

• Experience processing for independent mortgage brokers (not exclusively retail lenders or bank mortgage departments).

• Proven success managing team-based processing structures (registration, disclosures, order outs, submissions, conditions, closing).

• Tech-savvy and comfortable with: Google Workspace, Google Calendar, LOS systems, Calendly, video calls, Slack, email templates, screen sharing, etc.

Leadership Qualities

• Highly organized, proactive, and operationally rigorous.

• Strong people leader with the ability to coach, motivate, and elevate processing teams.

• Excellent communicator; able to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations, and broker partners.

• Startup-ready mindset: adaptable, resourceful, fast-moving, and positive under pressure.

title: Sales Representative – Telehealth (Patient Conversion)

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here - decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

About the Role
Working hours: 7am-3pm PT - off Sunday-Monday or Thursday-Friday
We’re hiring a Sales Representative to drive patient growth through both warm inbound lead conversion and outbound outreach.
You will own the full conversion journey - from first touch to scheduled calls.
This role requires both:

• Consultative selling skills for inbound leads

• Confidence and persistence for outbound calling and follow-up

This is not a passive, script-heavy call center role. It requires initiative, accountability, and comfort working independently in a remote startup environment.
What You Will Do

• Convert warm inbound leads

• Conduct outbound calls to re-engage cold or inactive leads

• Proactively reach out to potential patients through structured outbound campaigns

• Engage via phone, SMS, chat, and email

• Educate patients using approved, non-clinical messaging

• Handle objections with empathy and confidence

• Manage your own pipeline and prioritize follow-ups

• Maintain accurate CRM documentation

• Meet and exceed daily, weekly, and monthly conversion and activity KPIs

• Collaborate with care and operations teams for seamless onboarding

This is a phone-heavy role requiring strong follow-up discipline and consistent activity levels.
Why You Should Work Here

• Base + uncapped commission (performance-driven earning potential)

• Fully remote position

• Direct impact in one of the fastest-growing sectors in healthcare

• Startup culture where performance is recognized and rewarded

We reward results, ownership, and execution.
How You Will Contribute

• Drive revenue growth through both inbound and outbound sales efforts

• Increase patient conversion rates

• Improve follow-up systems to reduce lead drop-off

• Help refine outreach messaging and sales processes as we scale

• Maintain strong pipeline hygiene and reporting

This Describes You

• 3+ years of sales experience (inside sales, telesales, or high-ticket sales)

• Proven remote sales experience (required)

• Comfortable making 50+ calls per day when needed

• Experience in telehealth, healthtech, SaaS, DTC, or wellness preferred

• Strong hunter mentality with consultative selling ability

• Track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets

• Highly organized and self-motivated

• Professional-level English communication skills

• Comfortable working U.S. business hours

• Proficient with CRM systems, Slack, Dialpad, and spreadsheets

Note: Kindly send a Loom Video 30-sec of Self Introduction and Relevant Sales Experience.

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values.

Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours.

title: Product Assessor for Orthopaedic (Notified Body)
description:
As a Product Assessor, you will play a pivotal role in conducting orthopaedic product assessments and technical documentation reviews in strict adherence to European Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745) and the UK Medical Device Regulation (UK MDR 2002) and for Class IIa/IIb and/or Class III devices.
Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct thorough technical and clinical assessments of non-active orthopaedic medical devices under relevant commission regulation codes, with potential to extend expertise to dental devices.

• Identify and rectify instances where device technical documentation deviates from compliance with applicable requirements.

• Provide support for CE and UKCA marking activities within SGS .

• Contribute to the training and qualification of junior staff and develop comprehensive training materials.

• Communicate effectively with team members, clients, and other stakeholders regarding product assessments, working diligently to minimise regulatory risks associated with medical device certification.

• Ensuring diligent management of scheduled work to maintain timeliness and efficiency in deliverables.

We are seeking an experienced candidate with:

• 4+ years of professional experience in the orthopaedic products sector or related fields, covering roles in design, manufacturing, auditing, or research. Crucially, a minimum of two years should be directly involved in the design, manufacturing, and testing of orthopaedic products, or in roles that require a deep understanding of the scientific principles underlying these products or technologies.

• Understanding of essential standards for orthopaedic products.

• Prior experience in conducting orthopaedic product assessments for a Certification/Notified Body (acting as a Technical Documentation Reviewer) is advantageous.

• A Master's degree, PhD, or equivalent in a related discipline, such as medicine, biomedical engineering, or biomedical science, preferably with a focus on orthopaedic devices.

• Proficiency in modern electronic communication platforms.

• Strong written English skills essential for reviewing and querying Technical Documentation assessment reports.

• Demonstrated ability to learn independently.

• Desirable: Regulatory Acumen - knowledge of the European Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745) and the UK Medical Device Regulation (UK MDR 2002) and familiarity with medical device codes MDA/MDN/MDS for MDR as outlined in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/2185.

Why SGS ?

• Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.

• Enjoy a flexible schedule and work model.

• Access SGS University and Campus for continuous learning options.

• Thrive in a multinational environment, collaborating with colleagues from multiple continents.

• Benefit from our comprehensive benefits platform.

• Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.

• Collaborative instincts - Growth Platform sits at the intersection of backend, data, ML, and product. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Pricing Strategy team is part of Stripe's Product Marketing organization and is responsible for how Stripe prices its products. Our work is highly cross-functional and we partner closely with Product Management, Finance, and Sales to tackle some of Stripe's most visible and commercially impactful decisions. We're looking for someone who can blend financial analysis, strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and operational rigor to help us price new products and evaluate their pricing performance as the products evolve.

What you’ll do

You will support the development and execution of pricing and packaging strategies across Stripe’s existing and upcoming products. Working at the intersection of Product development, Go-to-Market, and financial planning, you will analyze pricing questions, develop recommendations, and help cross-functional teams move from insight to execution.

You will also play an important role in strengthening how the Pricing Strategy team operates - bringing structure and consistency to recurring processes, improving visibility into the team’s work, and identifying opportunities to help the team scale and increase impact.

Responsibilities

• Build an understanding of the value Stripe’s products deliver to users and how they compare with relevant alternatives

• Drive alignment across Finance, Legal, Product, and Go-to-Market stakeholders on pricing proposals and bring them to execution

• Leverage internal and research data to build financial models to evaluate the impact of pricing changes on revenue, margin, and user behavior

• Contribute to scalable tools and processes that help the Pricing Strategy team work more consistently and efficiently

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in pricing, strategy, operations, finance, product, or management consulting, ideally involving pricing, go-to-market, product recommendations, or other strategic business questions

• Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative user research on product needs and value perceptions, as well as market research and competitive benchmarking

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and a willingness to proactively work with functions across the company

title: [EU] Senior AML Specialist, Name Screening & Travel Rule
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 - connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Name Screening & Travel Rule AML Specialist to join our AML Operations team. The role is responsible for sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening across the customer lifecycle, while supporting Travel Rule compliance and exception handling for virtual asset transfers.

Key Responsibilities

•
Review and disposition screening alerts relating to sanctions, PEPs, adverse media, customers, counterparties and associated parties.

•
Investigate potential matches, document clear rationale, and escalate higher-risk or complex cases where required.

•
Support Travel Rule operations by reviewing originator and beneficiary information, resolving data discrepancies, failed transmissions and other exceptions.

•
Liaise with internal teams and counterparty VASPs to resolve screening and Travel Rule issues.

•
Monitor relevant sanctions and Travel Rule regulatory developments across the globe and support timely operational implementation.

•
Maintain accurate case records and support audits, regulatory enquiries and internal reviews.

•
Identify recurring false positives, exception trends and process gaps, and contribute to rule tuning, workflow improvements, automation and AI initiatives.

•
Work closely with internal AML Operations and Compliance teams on related escalations.

Requirements

•
3+ years of relevant AML Operations experience within financial services, fintech, payments or the virtual asset industry.

•
Hands-on experience in name screening, sanctions compliance and/or Travel Rule systems and operations

•
Good understanding of sanctions frameworks, PEP and adverse media screening, and FATF Travel Rule requirements.

•
Good understanding of virtual asset transactions, blockchain basics and associated AML/CFT risks.

•
Strong analytical, documentation and case-handling skills.

•
Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA or equivalent are advantageous.

Profile

•
Strong judgement and attention to detail, with the ability to make clear and defensible screening decisions.

•
Comfortable managing high-volume operational queues and prioritising time-sensitive cases.

•
Proactive in identifying gaps and improving processes, including through automation and AI.

•
Strong communicator with an interest in crypto, digital assets and financial crime prevention.

Why Join Us

title: Associate Scientist/Scientist I, Translational Biology
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We are seeking a driven and scientifically rigorous Associate Scientist with deep flow cytometry and cross-species tissue handling expertise to join our translational biology team. In this role, flow cytometry and ex vivo tissue processing are your core disciplines: you will independently isolate and process cells from liver, spleen, and whole blood across mouse, rat, NHP, and human samples, and execute complex multi-parameter panels to interrogate LNP uptake, cellular delivery, immune activation, and phenotypic response across in vitro and ex vivo models. Working closely with team leadership, you will help develop and refine assay strategy, contribute to experimental design, and complement this with a broader immunoassay and cell biology toolkit to evaluate lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery and therapeutic function. Beyond hands-on execution, you will interpret and contextualize data to inform project direction and partner with leadership to advance key scientific questions. You will help shape LILA's high-throughput, data-rich discovery workflows at the intersection of biology, automation, and AI, while mentoring junior team members on flow and tissue-processing technique and best practices.

What You'll Be Building

• Serve as a flow cytometry subject-matter expert: independently execute high-dimensional, multi-parameter panels to assess cell viability, LNP uptake, transfection/expression, immune activation, and marker phenotyping across primary and immortalized cell types; partner with leadership on panel design and assay development strategy.

• Own the full flow workflow: fluorophore selection and spectral considerations, compensation/unmixing, instrument setup and QC, acquisition, and rigorous analysis and interpretation in FlowJo (or spectral/conventional platform software); collaborate with leadership to develop and optimize new panels.

• Serve as a tissue processing and cell isolation expert: independently isolate viable single-cell suspensions and immune populations from liver, spleen, and whole blood across mouse, rat, NHP, and human samples, including perfusion, mechanical/enzymatic dissociation, density-gradient separation (PBMC/leukocyte), and RBC lysis; work with leadership to establish and optimize new cross-species workflows.

• Prepare and process tissues from in vitro and in vivo studies for downstream analysis (flow, ELISA, multiplex, qPCR), including homogenization, protein/RNA extraction, and lysate preparation; ensure high viability and yield for cross-species flow readouts.

• Drive flow-based readouts for LNP and delivery system performance across species and tissues, translating complex cytometry data into actionable insights that shape project direction.

• Run in vitro assays evaluating LNP and delivery system performance across readouts including IncuCyte, uptake, expression, knockdown, cytotoxicity, and innate immune activation.

• Execute high-throughput and plate-based screening experiments, including plate-based (high-throughput) flow, liquid handling, and data collection; contribute to screening design in partnership with leadership and the automation team.

• Oversee sample collection, aliquoting, labeling, and storage; ensure biorepository integrity and robust sample tracking across species and study types.

• Assist with development of multiplex immunoassays (MSD, Luminex, ELLA) for cytokine profiling, protein quantification, and immunogenicity assessment; support panel qualification, troubleshooting, and SOP authoring in collaboration with leadership.

• Analyze, interpret, and present experimental data at team and cross-functional meetings; translate results into actionable next steps and contribute to experimental strategy.

• Maintain detailed laboratory notebooks and electronic records with high data integrity; mentor junior scientists on flow cytometry technique, tissue processing/cell isolation, panel design, documentation, and troubleshooting.

title: Engineering Manager - Research Engineering
description:
Flow Traders is strengthening leadership across its Research Engineering department and is hiring an Engineering Manager. Research Engineers conduct applied research jointly with quants to deliver our trading models and research platform. As the firm scales, the quality of engineering management has become one of the most important factors in how well our teams grow, retain talent, and deliver - and this role exists to raise that bar.

Engineering Managers are accountable for the planning and people side of the organisation - project deliveries, growth, performance, culture and hiring - and partner with technical leads who own architecture, technical direction, and hands-on execution. The two work in close partnership; neither succeeds without the other.

You will be measured on the engineers you develop and the outcomes your team delivers. You will spend the large majority of your time leading people and managing delivery.

 

What you will do:

•
Own the roadmap: manage priorities, planning, and sequencing of the work in line with company goals.

•
Develop your engineers: own career planning, promotions, coaching, and structured, continuous performance management.

•
Plan and build the team: lead hiring, headcount planning, and resource allocation in line with the team's roadmap and the firm's priorities.

•
Cultivate a healthy team: actively manage culture, morale, and productivity, and address conflict early and constructively.

•
Lead with rhythm: hold regular one-on-ones, give clear and timely feedback, and invest in team building.

•
Translate technical and business requirements into clear delivery plans, identifying dependencies with other teams and risks up front.

•
Act as the liaison between Engineering, Trading, and Quant teams to design and roll out new products.

•
Drive delivery predictability: track progress against plan, manage risk and scope trade-offs, and report status clearly to stakeholders.

•
Continuously improve delivery processes and team velocity.

•
Ensure alignment: keep your team's work connected to organisational goals and delivery timelines, collaborating closely with Tech Leads and Staff Engineers on research and technical direction.

 

What you need to succeed:

•
Strong people-leadership skills: coaching, feedback, conflict resolution, and building an environment in which engineers thrive

•
Strong project management skills: experience building roadmaps, sequencing work, managing dependencies and risk, and driving delivery predictability in a fast-moving environment.

•
A technical or research background sufficient to earn the respect of the engineers you manage and to engage credibly in technical discussions.

•
Demonstrated experience leading, growing, and managing the performance of applied researchers and software engineers.

•
A track record of delivering applied research through a team, balancing scope, quality, and timelines.

•
Sound judgment in hiring and developing talent.

•
Excellent communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including experience managing cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Trading, Quant).

 

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders

title: Data Scientist
description:
This is a remote position.
About Monaire
Monaire is building the infrastructure layer for intelligent commercial HVAC. We combine on-device sensors, smart thermostats, and machine-learning systems to automate control, surface real operational insight, and materially reduce energy waste at scale. This is not offline modeling or notebook ML. Models run in production, interact with physical systems, and must be observable, debuggable, and correct. The platform spans edge devices, cloud services, streaming pipelines, control logic, and ML inference.

Engineers here work on:

• Data ingestion and streaming at scale from heterogeneous hardware

• Low-latency decision pipelines and control loops

• ML systems that survive missing data, drift, and adversarial real-world conditions

• Infrastructure for model deployment, monitoring, and rollback

• Apps and services that customers depend on to run their buildings every day

The market is large, broken, and technically underserved. We’re scaling the system and need engineers who care about correctness, performance, and ownership - people who want to build infrastructure that actually controls the physical world, not just dashboards that look good in demos.

Role Overview

As a Data Scientist / Senior Data Scientist , you will play a critical role in building production-grade ML systems that drive real-world outcomes-energy efficiency, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and operational intelligence for HVAC/R systems.

You will work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and domain experts to translate raw sensor data into reliable models that power customer-facing features and internal decision-making.

This role requires someone who can think long-term architecturally , while delivering short-term, measurable impact in a fast-moving startup environment.

What You'll Do:

• Scale ML systems for 5X growth-optimize batch processing, database queries, and model inference

• Design ML models for time-series data, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance

• Optimize production systems:

• Database optimization (MongoDB): indexes, connection pooling, 3-5X performance improvement

• Batch processing: parallel processing, async operations, memory management

• Model optimization:

• NLP & LLM: enhance conversational AI bots with intelligent query generation

• Build monitoring systems: real-time dashboards, SLA tracking, automated scaling

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

• 2+ years hands-on data science/ML experience

• Strong Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn)

• Deep learning: TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch

• MongoDB: Query optimization, indexing, aggregation pipelines

• Database optimization: Index design, query tuning

• Batch processing: Parallel processing (multiprocessing/async)

• Time-series data, anomaly detection, statistical modeling

• Strong CS fundamentals and debugging skills

Nice-to-Have Skills

• MLOps tools, Lambda optimization, caching (Redis/ElastiCache)

• Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus

• NLP/LLM: Prompt engineering, conversational AI

• IoT/sensor data experience, startup experience

• AWS: Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, ElastiCache/Redis

• Docker, SQL, Flask API development

Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in CS, IT, Applied Math, Statistics, or related field

Benefits

• Competitive salary + equity with meaningful ownership

• Comprehensive health insurance (self, spouse, children, and parents)

• Remote-first, flexible work culture

• Opportunity to work on high-impact systems with climate and sustainability impact

• Strong emphasis on engineering excellence, ownership, and growth

• ​ Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego team culture

title: Member of Technical Staff - Inference Runtime
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Modal’s Inference Runtime team owns the container runtime stack used to run inference and training workloads across our fleet. We work at the boundary of Linux, containers, filesystems, storage, GPU drivers, and distributed systems.Our goal is to make demanding ML workloads start quickly, run efficiently, and remain securely isolated - whether they use a single GPU, hundreds of gigabytes of memory, or multiple GPUs connected with RDMA.We’re looking for a systems engineer who enjoys working deep in the stack. You’ll build production runtime infrastructure in Rust and Go, diagnose difficult Linux and performance problems, and help determine the architecture of Modal’s container platform. You’ll also work closely with maintainers of gVisor and contribute to the runtime itself when the right fix belongs upstream.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

- Make container startup, checkpoint, and restore dramatically faster for large inference and training workloads.

- Build multi-GPU and accelerator-aware snapshotting, including efficient handling of GPU memory and RDMA-enabled workloads.

- Design zero-copy and low-copy data paths between container memory, filesystems, storage, and Modal’s runtime.

- Optimize large snapshot pipelines using techniques such as parallel uploads, direct I/O, incremental snapshots, and more efficient memory handling.

- Improve container image and filesystem performance across EROFS, FUSE, page caches, overlay filesystems, and remote storage.

- Extend our sandboxed runtime to support new GPUs, drivers, profiling tools, and device capabilities across NVIDIA and AMD hardware.

- Debug complex failures involving system calls, virtual memory, process lifecycle, kernel behavior, GPU drivers, and container isolation.

- Safely roll out runtime and kernel changes across a heterogeneous fleet using compatibility controls, scheduling constraints, feature flags, and observability.

- Work across the runtime, scheduler, storage, and GPU infrastructure-and take ambiguous production problems from investigation through deployment.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong Linux systems knowledge, particularly processes, virtual memory, filesystems, system calls, scheduling, namespaces, cgroups, and signals.

- Experience building or debugging container runtimes, sandboxes, Linux kernel, or similarly low-level infrastructure.

- Strong programming ability in Rust, Go, or another systems language, with an interest in becoming productive in both Rust and Go.

- Experience profiling and improving systems where memory movement, I/O, synchronization, or kernel interactions dominate performance.

- Comfort debugging across abstraction boundaries, from application behavior down through runtimes, drivers, and the kernel.

- An ability to turn loosely defined production problems into well-designed, reliable systems.

- A desire to own important infrastructure and work closely with both internal teams and customers.

PARTICULARLY RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

Any of the following would be helpful, but none is required:

- gVisor, runsc, runc, OCI runtimes, seccomp, or checkpoint/restore systems.

- Linux kernel development, virtualization, sandboxing, kernel modules, or device proxying.

- CUDA, ROCm, GPU drivers, accelerator virtualization, or GPU profiling.

- RDMA and high-performance networking.

- FUSE, EROFS, direct I/O, mmap, page-cache behavior, or storage engines.

- Large-memory or multi-GPU inference and training systems.

- Contributions to open-source systems software.

Prior gVisor or machine-learning experience is not required. We care more about strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.

WHY THIS ROLE

The container runtime is directly on the critical path for inference performance. Improvements here can substantially reduce cold starts, increase token throughput, unlock new accelerator types, and make previously impractical workloads possible.This is an opportunity to work

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

Lendable's Payments team transacts money for our UK Loans, AutoLend (motor finance) and Zable (credit card) products: disbursing loans, collecting repayments, refunding customers and reconciling everything against our banking providers.

We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated.

This is a hands-on operational role and a strong first job in fintech. You don't need finance experience; we'll teach you the payments side. You do need to be numerate, methodical, quick to learn and comfortable being the last line of defence before money leaves the building.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Daily funding controls (core responsibility)

- Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it.

- Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit.

- Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early.

- Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them.

- Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions.

Payments and finance operations

title: Principal TA Systems Architect

As a Principal TA Systems Architect, you will be the technical owner of the TA tech stack: the person who configures it, integrates it, secures it, measures it, and decides where it goes next. You will partner closely with the TA Operations who live in these systems every day, with the broader People Systems and People Analytics teams who own the HRIS and downstream data, and with IT, Security, Legal, and Procurement on access, privacy, and purchasing. • Run renewals and new purchases alongside Procurement and Finance: usage data, business case, and negotiation support.

• Hold vendors accountable to roadmap commitments and service levels; represent us in customer advisory boards and beta programs.

• Build and automate: Write the scripts, queries, and automations that eliminate manual work - data cleanup, bulk updates, custom reporting, alerting on integration failures.

• Build and maintain TA reporting and dashboards, and be the person who can definitively answer whether a recruiting number is right.

• Document the architecture, integrations, configuration decisions, and runbooks so the stack does not live in one person’s head.

• Proven experience with gathering business requirements, translating into technical solutions, and ultimately bringing solutions to life (project management, UAT, release management, and prod support).

title: Compliance Operations Analyst
description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will be Fin's first dedicated compliance operations hire, running the day-to-day engine of our compliance program. You report to the Head of Compliance.

Our compliance framework is in place: a Board-approved Compliance Charter, core programs for sanctions and financial crime, due diligence, fraud, complaints, third-party risk and records management, and a modern tooling stack. What we need now is someone who makes it run, every day, at the speed our customers move money.

This is a hands-on role. You will review real businesses, work real alerts, and help turn manual processes into automated, auditable workflows alongside engineering. Payment volume is growing quickly, and this role is how compliance capacity keeps pace.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

BUSINESS ONBOARDING AND DUE DILIGENCE

- Own the KYB/CDD review queue: use our tooling to verify legal entity, formation and DBA records, registered and operating addresses, website and commercial footprint, beneficial owners (25%+) and control persons.

- Manage customer risk rating process, and run enhanced due diligence on higher-risk profiles such as complex ownership, PEP exposure, high-risk industries or FATF-monitored jurisdictions.

- Issue and track RFIs, judge whether responses actually resolve the gap, and write clear disposition memos, including decline and exit recommendations.

SANCTIONS AND BLOCKCHAIN SCREENING

- Disposition sanctions, PEP and adverse media matches for entities and associated persons, with documented rationale.

- Triage blockchain analytics alerts on inbound and outbound transfers, and run hold-and-review workflows for flagged funds as pre-transaction interdiction comes online.

PARTNER, AUDIT AND PROGRAM READINESS

- Answer partner due diligence and information requests accurately and on time, and deliver against our partner reporting calendar.

- Write and maintain the procedures and runbooks that sit under our compliance programs.

PROCESS AND AUTOMATION

- Track and report operating metrics such as queue age, review turnaround, alert volumes, RFI aging and override rates.

- Spot recurring manual work and turn it into a tooling or workflow fix.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 1-4+ years in compliance operations at a fintech, payments company, crypto business or bank, with direct ownership of AML, KYB/CDD and/or EDD reviews.

- Strong business due diligence skills: you can untangle multi-layer ownership, read formation documents and registry records, and tell when a business's story does not add up.

- Experience investigating unusual activity and writing referrals or case narratives that another compliance team could act on without follow-up questions.

- Working knowledge of the BSA/AML framework, FinCEN guidance and FATF standards as they apply to payments and digital assets.

- Clear, precise writing. Your memos and RFIs hold up to partner, auditor and examiner review.

NICE TO HAVE

- CAMS, CAMS-FCI, CCI, CRCM or a similar certification.

- Experience with trade-based money laundering typologies or with wholesale, trading or import/export customers.

- Hands-on experience dispositioning sanctions, PEP and adverse media alerts, with a working knowledge of OFAC requirements.

- Experience with Persona, Middesk or similar KYB and case management platforms.

- Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools (such as Chainalysis or TRM) and with how stablecoin flows move on-cha

At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking an elite Product Sales Specialist to champion our Storage & Analysis product lines, the newest, most technically differentiated products in Cribl’s portfolio. Elite here means something specific: you don’t need a playbook handed to you, you write it. A successful Product Sales Specialist at Cribl thrives in white space, creating demand where none exists, developing messaging from first principles, and earning credibility with technical practitioners and executive buyers alike. You will own the full motion from pipeline creation through close, partner closely with Regional Sales Managers to drive deals forward, and provide the product and go-to-market insights that shape how we take these products to market. This role is ideal for elite overlay sellers, top-performing Solutions Engineers ready to make the leap into a sales role, or early-stage sellers who have built motions from scratch and want to do it again at a company defining a category.

If you're ready to join a team that's redefining what it means to be a true Data Engine for IT and Security, this is your moment.  This position will be our first team member in EMEA and needs to be based in either the UK, Germany, Spain, or the Netherlands.

• Develop a business plan to exceed sales goals alongside the CEO and cross-functional partners including dedicated Storage & Analysis Solution Engineers

• Engage with Regional Sales Managers on qualified opportunities, actively collaborating with them on account, close, and success plans

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• 5+ years of Enterprise/Strategic sales or pre-sales experience in Security (SIEM & Observability) or IT infrastructure, including direct sellers, overlay specialists, or Solutions Engineers ready to transition into a closing role

• Experience working with at least one earlier stage start-up organization <1,000 employees or has demonstrated entrepreneurial skills throughout their career

title: Analista III de Martech Social & Conteúdo
Global Account Manager - North America Automotive
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Global Account Manager to help grow our relationships with automotive OEMs and suppliers. In this role, you will manage a portfolio of customer accounts and contribute to some of our largest strategic engagements, working closely with business development, engineering, product, legal, and finance teams. This role is based in Michigan and includes significant time on site with customers.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across executive leadership, engineering, program management, and purchasing

- Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and drive commercial activity from opportunity through signed agreement

- Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements and grow account revenue over time

- Partner with internal teams to ensure customer commitments are delivered and issues are resolved promptly

- Create and execute on account strategy, support executive engagements, and maintain accurate forecasts

We're looking for someone who has:

- Bachelor’s degree

- 3-8 years of sales experience

- Experience selling complex technology into CXOs, especially in automotive, robotics, or deep-tech

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a polished, professional presence with senior stakeholders

- Strong organizational skills, with experience managing multiple workstreams and deadlines effectively

- Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual/quarterly goals and targets

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

title: Senior Product Manager - Agentic Banking
description:
As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.

Why Join Q2 ?
Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology-and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

What Makes Q2 Special?
Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week-featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences-we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

SUMMARY
Q2 is seeking a Senior Product Manager to help build out our Agentic Banking product suite. You will work with multiple teams to deliver high-value, self-service offerings for roles across financial institution's back office. You will influence product strategy with internal and external teams, ensuring product, GTM and financial goals are achieved.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the product roadmap and lifecycle for Agentic Banking Solutions.

• Define and execute product strategies aligned with customer needs, market trends, and business objectives.

• Develop business cases, pricing, packaging, financial forecasts, and investment recommendations for new products and enhancements.

• Monitor product performance, adoption, financial results, and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

• Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Compliance, and Operations to successfully deliver product initiatives.

• Represent the product with customers, prospects, and industry stakeholders, serving as a subject matter expert on back-office banking workflows and the Agentic Solutions that solve for them.

• Communicate product strategy, roadmap, and business value to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE

• Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience. Some barriers to entry exist at this level, requiring
department review.

• Demonstrable experience in software product management or similar roles

• 4+ years experience in the Financial Services industry and/or strong understanding of banking operations (ex: customer support, compliance, deposit operations, payment processing, digital banking, lending, etc.)

• Strong team leadership, including building, growing, motivating, and mentoring high-performance teams

• Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

• Strong teamwork, organization, and problem-solving abilities

• Excel and data analysis proficiency

• Self-starter with ability to deliver results independently

• *Familiarity with using AI Solutions, i.e. Claude, ChatGPT

• *Understanding of how AI systems operate (Tokenomics, Agent Development, Skills Writing, etc.)

This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.

• Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
